Four Arrested in Kerala for Alleged MDMA Supply, Including Social Media Influencer

Police in Malappuram, Kerala, have arrested four individuals, including social media influencer Minu Jasmin, for allegedly possessing and supplying MDMA. Authorities stated the accused were part of a network distributing the drug to students. The arrests were made with cash also seized.
